summary: # CLO 2025.1 - Mode & Editor Updates ## Introduction This video introduces the mode and editor-related updates for you. In the previous CLO version, when adding a project file, you could not choose the color scheme you wanted from the open file. To change the color scheme, you could only do it in the color editor after opening the file. ## New Color Scheme Selection From the current version, when adding a project file, you can choose the color scheme you want to open. This function is very useful when you want to design a clothing style and also add a specific color scheme to the current project. 1. **Adding a Project File:** - Find the file. - Add the project. - Open the project file you want. - In the window that pops out, the color option is added below the clothing. 2. **Selecting the Color Scheme:** - In the drop-down menu, select the color scheme to be added. - You can choose "All" or customize it. - Click the color button on the right to select the color scheme. The color scheme for each color will be displayed as the most fabric used in the clothing. > **Note:** Files created in the 2025.0 version or earlier will only display the name of the color scheme and not the color scheme itself. ## Project File Order and Color Scheme Preservation If you choose "All," the color schemes of the files you have added will be saved in the order of the project file. Click the same order to combine. Therefore, if you want them to match each other, the color scheme in both project files is very important for maintaining the same order and preservation. > **Important:** If you want to add fewer color schemes to projects that already have more color schemes, the first color scheme will fill in the remaining color schemes. ## Customizing Color Schemes When you want to customize the color scheme: 1. Find the file. 2. Increase the project. 3. Open the project file you want. 4. Click the right button at the bottom of the clothing in the pop-up window. 5. Open the color list to select the color scheme you want to add. The file will combine according to the selected color scheme. For example, if you select the second and third colors of the swimsuit suit, they will be added to the first two color schemes of the current project. The first color scheme selected from the added project will always be the combat suit and will combine with the remaining color schemes in the current project. ## Future Updates for Color Scheme Options In the future, more options will be added to mix and match color schemes from different projects. This update aims to help users improve the work efficiency of color combination design. ## Key Frame Animation Settings In the latest version of CLO, we have optimized the key frame animation settings. The main improvements include: - The color key frame animation now supports the twist material. - Key frame animation lighting in Vray rendering. - A new time-limited selection layer function. ### Adding Key Frames 1. Open the color editor. 2. Add the key frame to each color animation column. 3. Click the play preview effect to see the applied color key frame. This feature changes the color of the twist, making the animation transition more natural. ### Rendering Window Improvements Open the rendering window to access lighting settings. The light bulb icon has now been removed, but you can use the fire option to replace it. After using the fire option, you can set more content. Users can add key frames to various settings, such as: - Intensity - Angle - Color - Width and Height > **Note:** The light bulb key frame can be added to the animation, allowing control over the strength and angle of different stages of lighting. ### Circle Size Control We have also improved the control of the circle size setting. After starting this setting, you can edit the radius, head shadow height, and ground mix settings. Each setting can also be added to the key frame. Finally, you can adjust the time range of the current animation. Click on the right on the animation layer to limit the time range to the selected layer. Once you've made your adjustments, select to render the animation to receive the twist color and light. ## Virtual Model Animation Support In the previous version, the project with GLTF format was not supported for virtual model animation. Consequently, any joint animation applied to virtual models or animations based on storage would not be saved. In the new version, you can now choose to include virtual model animation, providing greater flexibility for animation processing. ### Exporting Virtual Model Animation 1. Find the file and select to export GLTF 2.0. 2. In the window, select all virtual models. 3. In the options below, select virtual model animation. 4. Choose the animation type you want. When you want to keep the structure of Google to edit or play in the future, this is an ideal choice. For binding Google's model, the best choice is to implement high guarantee animation. You can flexibly choose the export settings that best fit your project needs, ensuring better compatibility with files. Whether you are focused on creating an interactive experience or high-quality visual display, this function enhances your freedom in creating and performing virtual model animations. Thank you for watching!
